data.one_liner: Capture any widget as an image, including invisible widgets, at runtime.
data.what_it_does: This package wraps a widget in a RenderRepaintBoundary and provides methods to capture it as a Uint8List. It supports capturing widgets not in the tree, long widgets, and saving or sharing the resulting image.
use_when: Need to take screenshots of widgets for sharing or saving
Want to capture widgets that are not currently rendered
Need to generate images from UI components for reports or previews
avoid_when: Working on web only, as captureAndSave is not supported
Using platform views like Google Maps or Camera, which are unsupported
strengths: Simple API, works on all platforms except web for saving
weaknesses: Not supported for web when saving
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and import package, create ScreenshotController, wrap widget with Screenshot widget
